claims.text: Adding less than 1 at.% boron to MnNiSi-based magnetic-refrigeration materials enhances grain-boundary cohesion.
Enhanced grain-boundary cohesion improves the mechanical performance of MnNiSi-based materials.
Boron doping below 1 at.% increases compressive strength by at least 15% relative to the as-synthesized state.
Boron-doped MnNiSi-based materials retain a large magnetocaloric effect.
The proposed strengthening and magnetocaloric-effect retention hold between 20 and 50 °C and at magnetic fields up to 2 T.

contradictions.description: The prediction requires at least a 15% compressive-strength increase, but the falsification rule rejects the hypothesis only if strength decreases. An unchanged strength or an increase below 15% would violate the prediction without satisfying the stated falsification rule.
